To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a heat sink with the narrow flow passage can obtain a higher cooling performance than that with the wide flow passage, because the narrow flow passage of the heat sink can reduce the flow resistance of airflow and can generate the high pressure airflow from the piezodelectric micro blower.
the cooling performance of the impinging jet is strongly affected by the dimensions of the heat sinks.
the cooling performance of the impinging jet of the piezeelectric micro blower depends on the heat sink dimensions, especially the distance between the heat sink and the blower.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the novel cooling method of electronic equipment using the piezoelectrict micro blower.
an investigation of a cooling performance of the impinging jet generated from the piezolelectric micro blower in the narrow clearance.
a development of a novel cooling method which can be used for the high-density packaging equipment by combining a piezoelectric actuator and a micro blower.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the heat sink with a narrow channel between heat sink fins is effective for improving cooling performance.
the piezoelecric micro blower is very useful as a novel cooling device in the high-density packaging electronic equipments.
the heat sink with a large heat transfer surface area is preferable for cooling performance of the impinging jet of the piezoolectric micro blower.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the piezoelectrical micro blower is useful for the cooling of electronic components.
the piezoelectirc micro blower can improve a cooling performance of the electronic equipment with a small size.
the cooling performance of a heat sink with the jet from the micro blower can be significantly improved by changing the heat sink dimensions and the jet direction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the heat sink with an optimum dimensions and type is effective for improving cooling performance.
the cooling performance of the impinging jet can be improved by changing the heat sink dimensions.

the cooling performance of the impinging jet can be improved by increasing a length-to-width aspect ratio (L/W) of the heat sink, but it is not always improved by increasing a width (W) of the heat sinks.
